title: CarvGPT: a multi-agent collaborative framework for cultural translation and digital innovation in traditional craft design
scope_note: 全文逐页规则筛查＋高相关证据页语义清点；证据链仅保留PDF原句定位，未使用旧表内容。
context_summary: The paper proposes CarvGPT, a multi-agent framework for cultural translation and digital innovation in traditional craft design. It integrates requirement analysis, cultural parsing, and visual generation to support designers in translating cultural connotations into design concepts.
